title: Hex Maniac Advance feature parity contract

sourceProduct.name: Hex Maniac Advance
sourceProduct.caveat: 0.5.6.1 is marked latest/stable; 0.6.0/0.6.1 capabilities tracked without requiring their reported regressions

statusDefinitions.not_verified: Mapping to general capability is not native functional parity. Requires independent HMA-equivalent end-to-end acceptance.
statusDefinitions.verified: Verified against target original engine/revision including save/reimport and game execution.

acceptanceGate: Each feature must work for its applicable supported GBA engine/revision through Import → Inspect → Edit → Save → Reopen → Export → Execute → Reimport → Verify; unsupported source edits preserve original bytes.

features.name: Raw byte/hex editing, text-as-hex and search
features.acceptance: Read, edit, undo, save and export arbitrary original bytes without losing metadata

features.name: Copy/paste, overwrite, range selections and byte-level diff
features.acceptance: Compare before/after ROM bytes, paste a range and reimport exactly

features.name: Address goto, back/forward navigation and quick goto shortcuts
features.acceptance: Jump by offset or name and retain navigation history

features.name: Semantic pointer rendering and follow-pointer navigation
features.acceptance: Display typed pointers and follow them to safe in-ROM targets

implementationEvidence.limitations: Pointer rendering/follow supports candidate and HMA offset pointers; semantic engine ownership remains unverified.

features.name: Named anchors, format strings and editable metadata
features.acceptance: Inspect, create and change named anchor/format without corrupting raw data

features.name: Import/export HMA TOML metadata and preserve custom anchors
features.acceptance: Round-trip .toml metadata alongside ROM, including table formats and renamed anchors

implementationEvidence.limitations: HMA TOML source imported losslessly; no full arbitrary metadata schema/writeback or rewriting unsupported anchors.

features.name: Pointer-source and show-uses cross-reference navigation
features.acceptance: List all verified ROM address users of table/text/image/code pointers

implementationEvidence.limitations: Aligned/unaligned direct pointer match and named-anchor where-used; dynamic computed references not inferred.

features.name: Safe free-space detection, relocation and repointing
features.acceptance: Grow a resource and rewrite only proven owned pointer sources

implementationEvidence.limitations: Verified same-count table copy-on-write and explicit pointer-site repoint; no automatic expansion or generalized bytecode owner analysis.

features.name: Unknown/unrecognized data preserved byte-for-byte
features.acceptance: Export and reimport unmodified unknown byte ranges identical to source

features.name: ROM revision and model compatibility fingerprinting
features.acceptance: Recognize all HMA-supported game/revision combinations with confidence

features.name: Internal hex bookmarks, meaningful formats and contextual data preview
features.acceptance: Bookmark and inspect formatted data from an on-screen hex selection

features.name: ROM metadata sidecar, named tables and custom override migrations
features.acceptance: Retain manually located tables after project reopen and validated revision migration

features.name: Generic typed ROM table editor with add/copy/delete rows
features.acceptance: Edit an arbitrary metadata-described table with safe row addition and native reimport

implementationEvidence.limitations: Manually defined fields and strict numeric HMA formats; not full row add/delete/reindex.

features.name: Linked table joins and synchronized expansion
features.acceptance: Expand related species names/stats/teaching tables as one transaction

features.name: Fields typed as enums, bitfields, pointers, numbers and text
features.acceptance: Preserve every native field and unknown enum across edit/reimport

implementationEvidence.limitations: Fixed native integer/pointer/ASCII fields; no generalized enum or bitfield support yet.

features.name: Table filters/search, selectable columns and direct references
features.acceptance: Search arbitrary tables, hide columns and jump to referenced rows

features.name: Inline pointers and linked child records in table fields
features.acceptance: Edit child data safely while retaining other users and ownership

features.name: Generic table structure/layout change and fixed-size constraints
features.acceptance: Reject engine-incompatible table resize and supply valid relocation plan

features.name: ROM constants editor (shiny odds, badges, Exp multipliers)
features.acceptance: Show exact revision-specific hook and verify changed constant in native engine

features.name: Miscellaneous lookup tables (Soundproof/Metronome/trainer payout/trades)
features.acceptance: Locate and safely edit named miscellaneous tables with reimport equality

features.name: Table order/reindex and reference remapping
features.acceptance: Reorder indexed data and update every verified reference

features.name: HMA-style metadata and schema definitions for expansions
features.acceptance: Load engine/revision-specific custom named tables, preserving incompatible records

implementationEvidence.limitations: Strict [field. field: field::]N known fixed layouts; complex/dynamic HMA tables read-only.
